question: Estimate the adoption of plant-based meat alternatives (Beyond Meat, Imagine Meats, GoodDot, Wakao) in metro India over next 3 years.
idealClarificationQuestions: Active monthly buyers (purchased in past month)? Yes.
Both retail (BB, Zepto, Blinkit) and HoReCa (restaurants serving)? Both.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total metro non-veg consumers → flexitarian + health-conscious subset → plant-based trial → repeat.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Metro adult non-veg consumers: ~80M (~60% of metro adults are non-veg).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, tried plant-based meat at least once: ~20% in 2026 = 2M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Drivers to 2029: price drops (currently 2-3x meat), variety, restaurant penetration (BurgerKing, McDonald's veg options).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~1M monthly buyers in metros by 2029.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Health-conscious / climate-aware / animal welfare aware subset
Of these, tried plant-based meat at least once

benchmarkAssumptions.value: price drops (currently 2-3x meat), variety, restaurant penetration (BurgerKing, McDonald's veg options).

calculationFlow: Health-conscious / climate-aware / animal welfare aware subset: ~10-12% = 9-10M (TAM).
Of these, tried plant-based meat at least once: ~20% in 2026 = 2M.
